info.description: One past edition on the timeline: what it was called, when it was, and the snapshots a visitor opens from it.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Name
edit.description: What that edition was called, such as "Reclaiming Cool".

edit.label: Year
edit.description: Shown at the head of the row. A year rather than a date, and a word rather than a number, so that "2019–20" is sayable.

edit.label: Description
edit.description: A sentence or three about that edition, shown on the timeline beside the pictures.

edit.label: Featured images
edit.description: Exactly three, fanned out on the timeline and spread apart when a visitor points at the row. The first sits in front. They are decoration for the row, not the snapshots — those are below.

edit.label: Snapshots
edit.description: What a visitor sees after pressing "See Snapshots". On a large, tall screen each one of these is a slide of its own, side by side; anywhere else they are a single column the visitor scrolls. Everything here is drawn white on black: the snapshots open in a dialog that forces its own colours, so a text colour chosen inside it does not apply.
